diagnosis.root_cause: The controlled test used Supabase Auth inviteUserByEmail directly. Intended workspace and owner role existed only in Auth user metadata. The canonical workspace invitation command was bypassed, so no durable workspace_invitations row, application token, acceptance command, membership transaction, or workspace access audit could run.
diagnosis.affected_boundary: Any direct Supabase Admin invitation that assumes Auth metadata provisions application workspace access.
diagnosis.canonical_team_invitation_limitation: The existing application workflow supports non-owner workspace roles and requires explicit acceptance, but was not integrated with Supabase invitation/password setup for controlled Admin-owner onboarding.
diagnosis.callback_behavior: Authentication succeeded and password completion used the profile role default /dashboard destination. It did not verify workspace provisioning or preserve an invitation-acceptance destination.
diagnosis.unprovisioned_access: The dashboard data boundary resolved no active membership and did not load workspace commerce/data. However, it rendered the normal application shell and offered owner workspace initialization based only on profile role, which was incompatible with a pending targeted invitation.
diagnosis.retained_audit_available: Resend delivery evidence, sanitized test evidence, and this diagnosis remain. No canonical workspace invitation/activity existed to retain.
